notes.title: Server migration update release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Le Havre: The Inland Port will be migrated to our new server with this update! Please check our website for more information, especially about which data of your account was migrated and which not.

What's new?
- Main menu 2.0 implementation
- Added Lobby feature, new profile (+ Avatar customization window, Frames, Corners, Badges)
- Reset of ranking and added Legacy Ranking List (Top 100 Players)
- User Account migration to the new server.
- UI adjustments

Your Team DIGIDICED

notes.title: Le Havre gets update to work with newly released Patchwork
notes.notes:
We just released our second Uwe Rosenberg game Patchwork:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/528250/  
Both our games share avatars, chat and ingame friendlists.  

In the latest update we have prepared Le Havre to work with its new gaming brother. :)

Cheers!
